criteria.text: Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.2 is stated as $21,600,000 but 15% of the $160,000,000 Purchase Price is $24,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $1,600,000 (2 x ($7,300,000 - $6,500,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $1,200,000 is wrong.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 22 June 2028 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 22 June 2030 (48 months after Closing).
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $159,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $158,180,000 is wrong.
Flags the inconsistency between the SPA and employment agreement non-compete periods.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (15% x $160,000,000 = $24,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $21,600,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
